title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by calculating subset accuracy independently for affirmative and negative queries to detect 'Yes-bias' (over-reliance on positive linguistic priors), and using Macro-averaged Precision, Recall, and F1-score in multiple-choice tasks to assess 'option bias' and reliance on simple text-based elimination.
Evaluated by systematically comparing model performance, accuracy drops, and hallucination rates across two distinct data sources: authentic real-world videos versus AI-generated video content.
